items.title: EMURGO and Yoroi Set November 30 Date to Deregister Their Cardano DReps
items.description: EMURGO announced that its EMURGO and Yoroi Delegated Representatives are scheduled to deregister on November 30, 2026. Delegators are advised to choose another active DRep before the deadline to maintain governance representation and avoid interruption to reward withdrawals under current rules. This concerns governance delegation, not stake-pool delegation. EMURGO noted that the date may be extended in exceptional circumstances.

items.title: Cardano Foundation Opens Its 2026 Developer Ecosystem Survey
items.description: The Cardano Foundation has opened its 2026 developer ecosystem survey until November 30. For the first time, survey questions and responses are recorded on Cardano using CIP-179. The survey takes about 15 minutes, is available to developers in technical roles, and does not require ADA or a wallet. Responses are public on-chain data.

items.title: Cardano Consensus Team Advances Leios Implementation
items.description: The Consensus Team reported further Leios implementation work on the project's main development branch. Updates include forging endorser blocks in the Dijkstra era, storing them in LeiosDB, checking certificates before chain selection, and relaying Leios votes. These are development milestones, not confirmation that Leios has been deployed on Cardano Mainnet.

items.title: Plutus Core Advances CIP-0168 Builtins and Conformance Testing
items.description: The Plutus Core team finalized cost models for the keepPolicies and dropPolicies builtins under CIP-0168 and added 65 conformance test cases for new Value builtins. The team also updated the Plutus Core specification and continued work on metatheory and compiler improvements. The update describes ongoing development, not a separate Mainnet release.

items.title: Mithril Team Reports Progress on SNARK Keys and IPFS Distribution
items.description: The Mithril team resolved deterministic SNARK verification key collisions, measured the download time of a Cardano Mainnet database through IPFS on dev-mainnet, and implemented a ratio for IPFS downloads in the client. Work also continued on SNARK activation, archive migration, and compatibility with Cardano node 11.2. This is a development update, not a new production release.
